entities.summary: Italy-Azerbaijan University is a higher education institution established in 2022 through a collaboration between ADA University and five Italian universities: Luiss University, University of Bologna, Politecnico di Milano, Politecnico di Torino, and Sapienza University of Rome. The Italy-Azerbaijan University focuses on disciplines such as design and architecture, agriculture and food sciences, business and engineering, providing a platform for collaborative research, student exchanges, and joint degree programs.
